findings.evidence: PR description: "it remains to prove the tensor stalk comparison is an isomorphism". `grep -i 'fibre|fiber' TauCeti/Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/Sheaf/` returns only this docstring line. Roadmap README:348 defines the fibre as `E_x ⊗ k(x)`, a residue-field base change, not a tensor of stalks. Contrast InternalHom/Stalk.lean:18: "the comparison is not asserted to be invertible".
findings.fix: Replace both sentences with what the file delivers: a comparison map, over an arbitrary space and arbitrary module sheaves, whose values on germs of pure tensors are computed here. State explicitly that invertibility is not asserted, as InternalHom/Stalk.lean does.
findings.issue: "It also provides the local calculation used to identify fibres of algebraic vector bundles" is unsupported: no fibre notion exists in the repo for this, and identifying fibres would require the comparison to be invertible, which this PR does not prove. "The stalkwise map underlying the compatibility of module pullback with tensor products" is in-flight roadmap narrative — the file contains no pullback.

findings.evidence: Lines 183-189: the argument is `germ (tensorProduct R M N).val.presheaf U x hx ((tensorProductIso R M N).inv.val.app (op U) (unit.app (M.val ⊗ N.val) ... (m ⊗ₜ n)))`. `tensorProductIso` is "the defining identification" per TensorProduct/Basic.lean:105.
findings.fix: Say: sends the germ of the pure tensor `m ⊗ₜ n`, pushed through the sheafification unit and transported along `tensorProductIso`, to the tensor product of the germs of `m` and `n`.
findings.issue: Docstring says the lemma is about "the germ of the sheafification of a pure tensor", but the argument is the image of the sheafification-unit section under `(tensorProductIso R M N).inv`; the transport along the defining iso — the non-obvious part of the statement — is unmentioned, and "its two germs" does not say whose germs.

findings.evidence: Lines 22-25 list only the two defs; the only other public declarations are the simp lemmas at lines 116 and 179, and no ext or uniqueness lemma appears in the file.
findings.fix: Weaken to "its values on germs of pure tensors are computed", and add `tensorPresheafStalkComparison_germ_tmul` and `tensorStalkComparison_germ_unit_tmul` to the Main declarations list (as InternalHom/Stalk.lean:26 does for its germ lemma).
findings.issue: "It is characterized on germs of pure tensors" promises a characterization, but the file proves no uniqueness/ext statement, and at the sheaf level the only equation covers germs of unit-images transported along `tensorProductIso` rather than arbitrary germs. The `Main declarations` list also omits the two public germ lemmas, so the docstring never points at the equations that are supposed to supply the characterization.

summary: The module docstring's purpose paragraph claims results this PR does not deliver (fibre identification, pullback compatibility) and never discloses that the comparison is not asserted to be invertible, unlike the sibling InternalHom/Stalk.lean. The sheaf-level germ lemma's docstring also misdescribes its own left-hand side.
